   156→    def evolve(self, **kwargs) -> "Context":

   158→        Create a new context without merging together attributes
   159→        """
   160→        cls = self.__class__
   161→
   162→        if "ref_values" in kwargs:
   163→            new_ref_values = self.ref_values.copy()
   164→            new_ref_values.update(kwargs["ref_values"])
   165→            kwargs["ref_values"] = new_ref_values
   166→
   167→        for f in fields(Context):
   168→            if f.init:
   169→                kwargs.setdefault(f.name, getattr(self, f.name))

   173→    def ref_value(self, instance: str) -> Iterator[Tuple[str | list[str], "Context"]]:
   174→        if instance in PSEUDOPARAMS and instance not in self.pseudo_parameters:
   175→            return
   176→
   177→        if instance in self.ref_values:
   178→            yield self.ref_values[instance], self
   179→            return
   180→
   181→        # Non regionalized items first
   182→        if instance in _PSEUDOPARAMS_NON_REGION and instance in self.pseudo_parameters:
   183→            pseudo_value = _get_pseudo_value(instance)
   184→            if pseudo_value is not None:
   185→                yield pseudo_value, self.evolve(ref_values={instance: pseudo_value})
   186→            return
   187→        if instance in self.parameters:
   188→            for v, path in self.parameters[instance].ref(self):
   189→
   190→                # validate that ref is possible with path
   191→                # need to evaluate if Fn::If would be not true if value is
   192→                # what it is
   193→                yield v, self.evolve(
   194→                    path=self.path.evolve(
   195→                        value_path=deque(["Parameters", instance]) + path
   196→                    ),
   197→                    ref_values={instance: v},
   198→                )
   199→            return
   200→
   201→        # Regionalized values second
   202→        if instance in PSEUDOPARAMS and instance in self.pseudo_parameters:
   203→            for region in self.regions:
   204→                # We can resolve all region based pseudo values
   205→                # as we are now deciding on a region.
   206→                yield _get_pseudo_value_by_region(instance, region), self.evolve(
   207→                    regions=[region],
   208→                    ref_values={
   209→                        p: _get_pseudo_value_by_region(p, region)
   210→                        for p in PSEUDOPARAMS
   211→                        if p not in _PSEUDOPARAMS_NON_REGION
   212→                    },
   213→                )

   273→class Parameter(_Ref):
   274→    """
   275→    This class holds a parameter and its attributes
   276→    """
   277→
   278→    type: str = field(init=False)
   279→    default: Any = field(init=False)
   280→    allowed_values: Any = field(init=False)
   281→    description: str | None = field(init=False)
   282→
   283→    parameter: InitVar[Any]
   284→
   285→    def __post_init__(self, parameter) -> None:
   286→        if not isinstance(parameter, dict):
   287→            raise ValueError("Parameter must be a object")
   288→        self.default = None
   289→        self.allowed_values = []
   290→        self.min_value = None
   291→        self.max_value = None
   292→        self.no_echo = False
   293→
   294→        t = parameter.get("Type")
   295→        if not isinstance(t, str):
   296→            raise ValueError("Type must be a string")
   297→        self.type = t
   298→
   299→        self.description = parameter.get("Description")
   300→
   301→        # SSM Parameter defaults and allowed values point to
   302→        # SSM paths not to the actual values
   303→        if self.type.startswith("AWS::SSM::Parameter::"):
   304→            return
   305→
   306→        if self.type == "CommaDelimitedList" or self.type.startswith("List<"):
   307→            if "Default" in parameter:
   308→                default = parameter.get("Default", "")
   309→                if isinstance(default, str):
   310→                    self.default = default.split(",")
   311→                else:
   312→                    self.default = [default]
   313→            for allowed_value in parameter.get("AllowedValues", []):
   314→                if isinstance(allowed_value, str):
   315→                    self.allowed_values.append(allowed_value.split(","))
   316→                else:
   317→                    self.allowed_values.append([allowed_value])
   318→        else:
   319→            self.default = parameter.get("Default")
   320→            self.allowed_values = parameter.get("AllowedValues")
   321→
   322→        self.min_value = parameter.get("MinValue")
   323→        self.max_value = parameter.get("MaxValue")
   324→        if parameter.get("NoEcho") in list(BOOLEAN_STRINGS_TRUE) + [True]:
   325→            self.no_echo = True
   326→
   327→    def ref(self, context: Context) -> Iterator[Tuple[Any, deque]]:
   328→        if self.allowed_values:
   329→            for i, allowed_value in enumerate(self.allowed_values):
   330→                if isinstance(allowed_value, list):
   331→                    yield [str(x) for x in allowed_value], deque(["AllowedValues", i])
   332→                else:
   333→                    yield str(allowed_value), deque(["AllowedValues", i])
   334→            # assume default is an allowed value so we skip it
   335→            return
   336→
   337→        if self.default is not None:
   338→            if isinstance(self.default, list):
   339→                yield [str(x) for x in self.default], deque(["Default"])
   340→            else:
   341→                yield str(self.default), deque(["Default"])
   342→
   343→        if self.min_value is not None:
   344→            yield str(self.min_value), deque(["MinValue"])
   345→
   346→        if self.max_value is not None:
   347→            yield str(self.max_value), deque(["MaxValue"])

   409→def create_context_for_template(cfn):

   394→    def _patch_provider_schema(
   395→        self, content: Dict, source_filename: str, region: str
   396→    ) -> Dict:
   397→        """Provides the logic to patch a CloudFormation provider schema file.
   398→
   399→        Args:
   400→            content: A Dict representing the data that needs to be patched
   401→            source_filename: The source filename for the JSON patches
   402→            region: The region to apply the patch against
   403→        Returns:
   404→            Dict: returns the patched content
   405→        """
   406→        for patch_type in ["extensions", "providers"]:
   407→            source_dir = source_filename.replace("-", "_").replace(".json", "")
   408→            append_dir = os.path.join(
   409→                self._patches.path_relative, patch_type, region, source_dir
   410→            )
   411→            for dirpath, _, filenames in os.walk(append_dir):
   412→                filenames.sort()
   413→                for filename in fnmatch.filter(filenames, "*.json"):
   414→                    file_path = os.path.basename(filename)
   415→                    module = dirpath.replace(f"{append_dir}", f"{region}").replace(
   416→                        os.path.sep, "."
   417→                    )
   418→                    try:
   419→                        jsonpatch.JsonPatch(
   420→                            load_resource(
   421→                                f"{self._patches.module}.{patch_type}.{module}.{source_dir}",
   422→                                file_path,
   423→                            )
   424→                        ).apply(content, in_place=True)
   425→                    except jsonpatch.JsonPatchConflict as e:
   426→                        LOGGER.info(
   427→                            "Patch already applied %s: %s",
   428→                            os.path.join(append_dir, file_path),
   429→                            str(e),
   430→                        )
   431→                    except jsonpatch.JsonPatchException as e:
   432→                        LOGGER.info(
   433→                            "Patch exception raised for %s: %s",
   434→                            os.path.join(append_dir, file_path),
   435→                            str(e),
   436→                        )
   437→                    except Exception as e:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
   438→                        LOGGER.info(
   439→                            "Unknown exception raised applying patch %s: %s",
   440→                            os.path.join(append_dir, file_path),
   441→                            str(e),
   442→                        )

   444→        return content

   446→    def patch(self, filename: str, regions: Sequence[str]):
   447→        try:
   448→            with open(filename, encoding="utf-8") as fp:
   449→                custom_spec_data = json.load(fp)
   450→                schema_patch = SchemaPatch.from_dict(custom_spec_data)
   451→                for region in regions:
   452→                    self._patch(schema_patch, region)
   453→        except IOError as e:
   454→            if e.errno == 2:
   455→                LOGGER.error("Override spec file not found: %s", filename)
   456→                sys.exit(1)
   457→            elif e.errno == 21:
   458→                LOGGER.error(
   459→                    "Override spec file references a directory, not a file: %s",
   460→                    filename,
   461→                )
   462→                sys.exit(1)
   463→            elif e.errno == 13:
   464→                LOGGER.error(
   465→                    "Permission denied when accessing override spec file: %s", filename
   466→                )
   467→                sys.exit(1)
   468→        except ValueError as err:
   469→            LOGGER.error("Override spec file %s is malformed: %s", filename, err)
   470→            sys.exit(1)

   472→    def _patch(self, patch: SchemaPatch, region: str) -> None:
   473→        """Patch the schemas as needed
   474→
   475→        Args:
   476→            patch: The patches to be applied to the schemas
   477→        Returns:
   478→            None: Returns when completed
   479→        """
   480→
   481→        resource_types = []
   482→        all_resource_types = self.get_resource_types(region)[:]
   483→        # Remove unsupported resource using includes
   484→        if patch.included_resource_types:
   485→            for include in patch.included_resource_types:
   486→                regex = re.compile(include.replace("*", "(.*)") + "$")
   487→                matches = [
   488→                    string for string in all_resource_types if re.match(regex, string)
   489→                ]
   490→
   491→                resource_types.extend(matches)
   492→        else:
   493→            resource_types = all_resource_types[:]
   494→
   495→        # Remove unsupported resources using the excludes
   496→        for exclude in patch.excluded_resource_types:
   497→            regex = re.compile(exclude.replace("*", "(.*)") + "$")
   498→            matches = [string for string in resource_types if re.match(regex, string)]
   499→            for match in matches:
   500→                resource_types.remove(match)
   501→
   502→        # Remove unsupported resources
   503→        removed_types = list(set(all_resource_types) - set(resource_types))
   504→        if removed_types:
   505→            for removed_type in removed_types:
   506→                self._removed_types.append(removed_type)
   507→            self.get_resource_schema.cache_clear()
   508→            self.get_resource_types.cache_clear()
   509→
   510→        for resource_type, patches in patch.patches.items():
   511→            try:
   512→                schema = self.get_resource_schema(
   513→                    resource_type=resource_type, region=region
   514→                )
   515→            except ResourceNotFoundError:
   516→                # Resource type doesn't exist in this region
   517→                continue
   518→            schema.patch(patches=patches)

   357→    def _search_deep_keys(self, searchText: str | re.Pattern, cfndict, path: Path):
   358→        """Search deep for keys and get their values.
   359→
   360→        Args:
   361→            searchText (str | re.Pattern): The text or regular expression pattern to search for.
   362→            cfndict (Any): The dictionary or list to search in.
   363→            path (list[Any]): The current path in the dictionary or list.
   364→
   365→        Returns:
   366→            list[list[Any]]: A list of paths where the searchText was found.
   367→        """
   368→        keys = []
   369→        if isinstance(cfndict, dict):
   370→            for key in cfndict:
   371→                pathprop: Path = path[:]
   372→                pathprop.append(key)
   373→                if isinstance(searchText, str):
   374→                    if key == searchText:
   375→                        pathprop.append(cfndict[key])
   376→                        keys.append(pathprop)
   377→                        # pop the last element off for nesting of found elements for
   378→                        # dict and list checks
   379→                        pathprop = pathprop[:-1]
   380→                elif isinstance(searchText, re.Pattern):
   381→                    if isinstance(key, str):
   382→                        if re.match(searchText, key):
   383→                            pathprop.append(cfndict[key])
   384→                            keys.append(pathprop)
   385→                            # pop the last element off for nesting of found elements for
   386→                            # dict and list checks
   387→                            pathprop = pathprop[:-1]
   388→                if isinstance(cfndict[key], dict):
   389→                    keys.extend(
   390→                        self._search_deep_keys(searchText, cfndict[key], pathprop)
   391→                    )
   392→                elif isinstance(cfndict[key], list):
   393→                    for index, item in enumerate(cfndict[key]):
   394→                        pathproparr = pathprop[:]
   395→                        pathproparr.append(index)
   396→                        keys.extend(
   397→                            self._search_deep_keys(searchText, item, pathproparr)
   398→                        )
   399→        elif isinstance(cfndict, list):
   400→            for index, item in enumerate(cfndict):
   401→                pathprop = path[:]
   402→                pathprop.append(index)
   403→                keys.extend(self._search_deep_keys(searchText, item, pathprop))
   404→
   405→        return keys

   407→    def search_deep_keys(
   408→        self, searchText: str | re.Pattern, includeGlobals: bool = True
   409→    ):
   410→        """Search for a key in all parts of the template.
   411→
   412→        Args:
   413→            searchText (str | re.Pattern): The text or regular expression pattern to search for.
   414→            includeGlobals (bool): Whether to include globals in the search.
   415→
   416→        Returns:
   417→            liist[[Any]]: A list of paths where the searchText was found.
   418→
   419→        Example:
   420→            If searchText is "Ref", the return value could be something like
   421→            ['Resources', 'myInstance', 'Properties', 'ImageId', 'Ref', 'Ec2ImageId']
   422→        """
   423→        results = []
   424→        results.extend(self._search_deep_keys(searchText, self.template, []))
   425→        # Globals are removed during a transform.  They need to be checked manually
   426→        if includeGlobals:
   427→            pre_results = self._search_deep_keys(
   428→                searchText, self.transform_pre.get("Globals"), []
   429→            )

   432→        return results

   434→    def get_condition_values(self, template, path: Path | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   435→        """
   436→        Evaluates conditions in the provided CloudFormation template and returns the values.
   437→
   438→        Args:
   439→            template (list): The CloudFormation template to evaluate.
   440→            path (list, optional): The current path in the template. Defaults to an empty list.
   441→
   442→        Returns:
   443→            list: A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary contains the following keys:
   444→                - "Path": The path to the condition value in the template.
   445→                - "Value": The value of the condition.
   446→        """
   447→        path = path or []
   448→        matches: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   449→        if not isinstance(template, list):
   450→            return matches
   451→        if not len(template) == 3:
   452→            return matches
   453→
   454→        for index, item in enumerate(template[1:]):
   455→            result: dict[str, Any] = {}
   456→            result["Path"] = path[:] + [index + 1]
   457→            if not isinstance(item, (dict, list)):
   458→                # Just straight values and pass them through
   459→                result["Value"] = item
   460→                matches.append(result)
   461→            elif len(item) == 1:
   462→                # Checking for conditions inside of conditions
   463→                if isinstance(item, dict):
   464→                    for sub_key, sub_value in item.items():
   465→                        if sub_key in cfnlint.helpers.CONDITION_FUNCTIONS:
   466→                            results = self.get_condition_values(
   467→                                sub_value, result["Path"] + [sub_key]
   468→                            )
   469→                            if isinstance(results, list):
   470→                                matches.extend(results)
   471→                        elif sub_key == "Ref":
   472→                            if sub_value != "AWS::NoValue":
   473→                                result["Value"] = item
   474→                                matches.append(result)
   475→                        else:
   476→                            # Return entire Item
   477→                            result["Value"] = item
   478→                            matches.append(result)
   479→                else:
   480→                    # Return entire Item
   481→                    result["Value"] = item
   482→                    matches.append(result)
   483→            else:
   484→                # Length longer than 1 means a list or object that
   485→                # should be fully returned
   486→                result["Value"] = item
   487→                matches.append(result)
   488→
   489→        return matches

   491→    def get_values(self, obj, key, path: Path | None = None):
   492→        """
   493→        Logic for getting the value of a key in the provided object.
   494→
   495→        Args:
   496→            obj (dict): The object to search for the key.
   497→            key (str): The key to search for in the object.
   498→            path (list, optional): The current path in the object. Defaults to an empty list.
   499→
   500→        Returns:
   501→            list: A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary contains the following keys:
   502→            - "Path": The path to the value in the object.
   503→            - "Value": The value found for the key.
   504→
   505→            Types of return values
   506→            - Returns None if the item isn't found
   507→            - Returns empty list if the item is found but Ref or GetAtt
   508→            - Returns all the values as a list if condition
   509→            - Returns the value if its just a string, int, boolean, etc.
   510→        """
   511→        path = path or []
   512→        matches = []
   513→
   514→        if not isinstance(obj, dict):
   515→            return None
   516→        value = obj.get(key)
   517→        if value is None:
   518→            return None
   519→        if isinstance(value, (dict)):
   520→            if len(value) == 1:
   521→                is_condition = False
   522→                is_no_value = False
   523→                for obj_key, obj_value in value.items():
   524→                    if obj_key in cfnlint.helpers.CONDITION_FUNCTIONS:
   525→                        is_condition = True
   526→                        results = self.get_condition_values(
   527→                            obj_value, path[:] + [obj_key]
   528→                        )
   529→                        if isinstance(results, list):
   530→                            for result in results:
   531→                                check_obj = obj.copy()
   532→                                check_obj[key] = result["Value"]
   533→                                matches.extend(
   534→                                    self.get_values(check_obj, key, result["Path"])
   535→                                )
   536→                    elif obj_key == "Ref" and obj_value == "AWS::NoValue":
   537→                        is_no_value = True
   538→                if not is_condition and not is_no_value:
   539→                    result = {}
   540→                    result["Path"] = path[:]
   541→                    result["Value"] = value
   542→                    matches.append(result)
   543→            else:
   544→                result = {}
   545→                result["Path"] = path[:]
   546→                result["Value"] = value
   547→                matches.append(result)
   548→        elif isinstance(value, (list)):
   549→            for list_index, list_value in enumerate(value):
   550→                if isinstance(list_value, dict):
   551→                    if len(list_value) == 1:
   552→                        is_condition = False
   553→                        is_no_value = False
   554→                        for obj_key, obj_value in list_value.items():
   555→                            if obj_key in cfnlint.helpers.CONDITION_FUNCTIONS:
   556→                                is_condition = True
   557→                                results = self.get_condition_values(
   558→                                    obj_value, path[:] + [list_index, obj_key]
   559→                                )
   560→                                if isinstance(results, list):
   561→                                    matches.extend(results)
   562→                            elif obj_key == "Ref" and obj_value == "AWS::NoValue":
   563→                                is_no_value = True
   564→                        if not is_condition and not is_no_value:
   565→                            result = {}
   566→                            result["Path"] = path[:] + [list_index]
   567→                            result["Value"] = list_value
   568→                            matches.append(result)
   569→                    else:
   570→                        result = {}
   571→                        result["Path"] = path[:] + [list_index]
   572→                        result["Value"] = list_value
   573→                        matches.append(result)
   574→                else:
   575→                    result = {}
   576→                    result["Path"] = path[:] + [list_index]
   577→                    result["Value"] = list_value
   578→                    matches.append(result)
   579→        else:
   580→            result = {}
   581→            result["Path"] = path[:]
   582→            result["Value"] = value
   583→            matches.append(result)
   584→
   585→        return matches

   668→    # pylint: disable=W0613,too-many-locals
   669→    def check_value(
   670→        self,
   671→        obj: dict[str, Any],
   672→        key: str,
   673→        path: Path,
   674→        check_value: CheckValueFn | None = None,
   675→        check_ref: CheckValueFn | None = None,
   676→        check_get_att: CheckValueFn | None = None,
   677→        check_find_in_map: CheckValueFn | None = None,
   678→        check_split: CheckValueFn | None = None,
   679→        check_join: CheckValueFn | None = None,
   680→        check_import_value: CheckValueFn | None = None,
   681→        check_sub: CheckValueFn | None = None,
   682→        pass_if_null: bool = False,
   683→        **kwargs: dict[str, Any],
   684→    ) -> list[RuleMatch]:
   685→        """
   686→        Check the value of a key in the provided object.
   687→
   688→        Args:
   689→            obj (dict): The object to check the value of.
   690→            key (str): The key to check the value of.
   691→            path (list): The path to the current location in the object.
   692→            check_value (callable, optional): A function to check the value of the key.
   693→            check_ref (callable, optional): A function to check the "Ref" function.
   694→            check_get_att (callable, optional): A function to check the "Fn::GetAtt" function.
   695→            check_find_in_map (callable, optional): A function to check the "Fn::FindInMap" function.
   696→            check_split (callable, optional): A function to check the "Fn::Split" function.
   697→            check_join (callable, optional): A function to check the "Fn::Join" function.
   698→            check_import_value (callable, optional): A function to check the "Fn::ImportValue" function.
   699→            check_sub (callable, optional): A function to check the "Fn::Sub" function.
   700→            pass_if_null (bool, optional): Whether to pass if the value is null. Defaults to False.
   701→            **kwargs (dict): Additional keyword arguments to pass to the check functions.
   702→
   703→        Returns:
   704→            list[RuleMatch]: A list of matches found during the check.
   705→        """
   706→        matches = []
   707→        values_obj = self.get_values(obj=obj, key=key)
   708→        new_path = path[:] + [key]
   709→        if values_obj is None and pass_if_null:
   710→            if check_value:
   711→                matches.extend(
   712→                    check_value(value=values_obj, path=new_path[:], **kwargs)
   713→                )
   714→        elif not values_obj:
   715→            return matches
   716→        else:
   717→            for value_obj in values_obj:
   718→                value = value_obj["Value"]
   719→                child_path = value_obj["Path"]
   720→                if not isinstance(value, dict):
   721→                    if check_value:
   722→                        matches.extend(
   723→                            check_value(
   724→                                value=value, path=new_path[:] + child_path, **kwargs
   725→                            )
   726→                        )
   727→                else:
   728→                    if len(value) == 1:
   729→                        for dict_name, _ in value.items():
   730→                            # If this is a function we shouldn't fall
   731→                            # back to a check_value check
   732→                            if dict_name in cfnlint.helpers.FUNCTIONS:
   733→                                # convert the function name from camel case
   734→                                # to underscore
   735→                                # Example: Fn::FindInMap becomes
   736→                                # check_find_in_map
   737→                                # ruff: noqa: E501
   738→                                function_name = f'check_{camel_to_snake(dict_name.replace("Fn::", ""))}'
   739→                                if function_name == "check_ref":
   740→                                    if check_ref:
   741→                                        matches.extend(
   742→                                            check_ref(
   743→                                                value=value.get("Ref"),
   744→                                                path=new_path[:] + child_path + ["Ref"],
   745→                                                parameters=self.template.get(
   746→                                                    "Parameters", {}
   747→                                                ),
   748→                                                resources=self.get_resources(),
   749→                                                **kwargs,
   750→                                            )
   751→                                        )
   752→                                else:
   753→                                    if locals().get(function_name):
   754→                                        matches.extend(
   755→                                            locals()[function_name](
   756→                                                value=value.get(dict_name),
   757→                                                path=new_path[:]
   758→                                                + child_path
   759→                                                + [dict_name],
